english: Monoprop at {mono} percent. You can play with the RCS.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: No lo digas dos veces.
english: Don't say it twice.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Genial. Voy a hacer piruetas.
english: Great. Time for some spins.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Batería al {ec} por ciento. Ni bien ni mal.
english: Battery at {ec} percent. Not good, not bad.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Energía al {ec} por ciento. Vigilad los paneles.
english: Power at {ec} percent. Keep an eye on the panels.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Recibido. Apagamos la luz del baño.
english: Copy. We'll turn off the bathroom light.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Ni bien ni mal. Como la comida de aquí.
english: Not good, not bad. Like the food up here.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Día {day}. Ya sois casi vecinos de allí arriba.
english: Day {day}. You're almost locals up there.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Llevamos {day} días. Aquí abajo os echamos de menos.
english: {day} days now. We miss you down here.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Ya? Se nos ha pasado volando.
english: Already? It flew by.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Pues aquí nadie se ha cambiado de calcetines.
english: Well, nobody up here has changed socks.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Os echamos de menos. Sobre todo la comida.
english: We miss you too. Mostly the food.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Una nave de solo {parts} piezas. Menos cosas que se rompan.
english: A ship of only {parts} parts. Fewer things to break.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Pequeño pero valiente.
english: Small but brave.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Menos piezas, menos tornillos sueltos.
english: Fewer parts, fewer loose bolts.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Un solo kerbal a bordo. Si te aburres, habla con las plantas.
english: Just one kerbal aboard. If you get bored, talk to the plants.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Las plantas no contestan. Ya lo he intentado.
english: The plants don't answer. I tried.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: Maniobra en menos de dos minutos. Atentos.
english: Burn in less than two minutes. Stand by.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: La maniobra está al caer. {node_dv} metros por segundo.
english: The burn is coming up. {node_dv} m/s.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Recibido. Que alguien despierte al piloto.
english: Copy. Someone wake up the pilot.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Maniobra anotada. Esta vez apuntamos hacia el lado bueno.
english: Burn noted. This time we'll point the right way.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Entendido. Esta vez leemos las instrucciones.
english: Understood. This time we read the manual.

speaker: mission_control
spanish: El escáner de superficie indica aproximadamente un {resource_pct} por ciento de {resource}.
english: The surface scanner reads about {resource_pct} percent {resource}.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Lectura anotada. Comprobaremos el lugar antes de perforar.
english: Reading noted. We will check the site before drilling.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Recibido, Control. Lo apuntamos en algún sitio.
english: Copy, Control. We'll write that down somewhere.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Gracias, Control. ¿Eso entra en el examen?
english: Thanks, Control. Will that be on the test?

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Entendido. No sé qué significa, pero entendido.
english: Understood. No idea what it means, but understood.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Recibido. La próxima vez, más despacio.
english: Copy. Slower next time.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Control, ¿podéis mandar eso también por escrito?
english: Control, can you send that in writing too?

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Anotado. En la pared, porque no tenemos papel.
english: Noted. On the wall, because we're out of paper.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Lo que tú digas, Control.
english: Whatever you say, Control.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Vale. Haremos como que lo entendemos.
english: Okay. We'll pretend we understand.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Gracias, Control. Nos alegráis el día.
english: Thanks, Control. You make our day.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Recibido. Seguimos aquí, por si alguien preguntaba.
english: Copy. Still here, in case anyone was wondering.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Gracias, Control. Muy interesante. De verdad.
english: Thanks, Control. Very interesting. Really.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: {vessel} recibe. Alto y claro.
english: {vessel} copies. Loud and clear.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Aquí {vessel}. Todo tranquilo por aquí arriba.
english: {vessel} here. All quiet up here.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¿Eso es bueno? Suena bien.
english: Is that good? Sounds good.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Lo apunto. No sé dónde, pero lo apunto.
english: I'll write that down. Not sure where, but I will.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: Gracias, Control. No he entendido nada.
english: Thanks, Control. I didn't understand a thing.

speaker: kerbal_a
spanish: ¡Hola, Control! Soy yo, desde el asiento de atrás.
english: Hi, Control! It's me, from the back seat.
